data.name: Inspiring Word
data.description: As a standard action, you can speak an inspiring word to a creature within 30 feet. That creature receives a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls, skill checks, ability checks, and saving throws for %1 rounds. You can use this power %2 times per day.|max(DomainNobilityLVL/2,1)|DomainNobilityTimes
